name: Statistical Modelling
description: Go beyond normal errors with generalised linear, nonparametric and Bayesian models.

requires.why: Reads logistic coefficients as log odds, extending logistic regression from the classification lessons to likelihood and IRLS.
Comparing several group means raises multiple-comparison corrections; only a small part is used.
Kernel density estimates and permutation tests use densities and sums of variables.
Builds Metropolis samplers and uses stationary distributions and detailed balance for Bayesian logistic regression.

lessonObjectives.l1-beyond-normal-errors: Choose a distribution and a link function for counts, proportions and yes or no outcomes.
lessonObjectives.l2-logistic-as-glm: Fit a logistic regression by maximum likelihood and read its coefficients as log odds.
lessonObjectives.l3-poisson-regression: Model trade counts with Poisson regression and an exposure offset.
lessonObjectives.l4-irls: Fit logistic and Poisson models by your own IRLS and match statsmodels.
lessonObjectives.l5-deviance: Compare GLMs by deviance and check for overdispersion.
lessonObjectives.l6-anova: Split variation into between-group and within-group parts.
lessonObjectives.l7-f-test: Test whether several group means differ with an F-test, and link it to regression.
lessonObjectives.l8-designing-an-experiment: Use randomisation, blocking and replication to design an experiment.
lessonObjectives.l9-execution-experiment: Design and analyse a randomised test of two execution algorithms.
lessonObjectives.l10-rank-tests: Use the Wilcoxon and Mann-Whitney tests when returns are far from normal.
lessonObjectives.l11-permutation-tests: Build a permutation test for a strategy’s edge and compare it with a t-test.
lessonObjectives.l12-kernel-density: Estimate a return density with a kernel and choose the bandwidth.
lessonObjectives.l13-robust-estimates: Use medians, trimmed means and robust regression when outliers dominate.
lessonObjectives.l14-conjugate-priors: Update Beta-binomial, Gamma-Poisson and normal models in closed form.
lessonObjectives.l15-posterior-predictive: Predict new data from the posterior and check a model against it.
lessonObjectives.l16-fitting-by-mcmc: Fit a Bayesian logistic regression by Metropolis sampling in code.
lessonObjectives.l17-has-it-converged: Check convergence with trace plots, several chains and the R-hat statistic.
lessonObjectives.l18-hierarchical-models: Pool many strategies’ hit rates with a hierarchical model and see the shrinkage.
